content:
Mara Nguyen: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — I distilled the postmortem actions into a small handoff/audit so we can close loops. Main points: cloud provider regional networking blip, model-registry auth token refresh failures, and our fallback routing didn't kick for one customer region. Need owners + dates.

Jason Li: I can own cloud-networking verification. I'll validate peering + route tables and vendor incident timelines. Target: 2025-06-05 for a remediation test.

Sophia Patel: Assign me for the model-registry auth flow. I want to add a token-refresh guard and a quick exp-backoff for retries. ETA: 2025-06-03.

Alejandro Cruz: Can take the fallback-routing smoke tests and chaos drill. Will coordinate with infra for a canary failover run. Proposed date: 2025-06-10.

Zoe Kim: I'll handle customer-impact comms and confirm which customers were affected. Need Jason's final timeline before I send a short note.

Mara Nguyen: Thanks — please ack in-thread. Also two cross-cutting asks: 1) short postmortem checklist to fold into the on-call runbook, 2) log retention tweak to keep auth traces for 30 days for correlation.

eng-bot: Reminder: created ticket INF-4321 (cloud-networking-verify) and TKT-9876 (model-registry-token-guard). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4321, https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/TKT-9876 :white_check_mark:

Jason Li: Ack. INF-4321 is updated with vendor timeline and a small playbook for next event. Also adding a step to validate cross-region routing tables using this script: 

```bash
# quick routing validation
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod | jq '.RouteTables[] | {RouteTableId, Routes}'
```

Sophia Patel: For token guard, plan is: 1) detect 401+ token-exchange errors, 2) switch to short-lived backup token if available, 3) escalate after 2 failed attempts. I'll add metrics: auth.errors, auth.fallback_used.

Alejandro Cruz: For the chaos test, I'll run a simulated auth-provider blackhole for 15m in staging and confirm fallback triggers. Need a confirmation window from product that a staging run is safe — tagging @ops_lead.

ops_lead: ops_lead: staging chaos for 15m is OK between 2025-06-08 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please include rollback steps and alert suppression.

Zoe Kim: Noted — I'll prep comms and a short customer FAQ.

Mara Nguyen: Good. Two smaller items: add an SLA proof artifact for vendor response times (attach to INF-4321) and set a monthly recurring review for any auth-related errors to spot patterns. Sophia, can you own the monthly review?

Sophia Patel: Yes, I'll own the monthly auth error review. First recurrence: 2025-06-30. Will add a short dashboard and a filter query for correlation with cloud-network events.

Jason Li: Quick note — vendor confirmed BGP flap between 2025-05-28T03:12Z and 03:24Z; adding to INF-4321. That aligns with increased latency windows we saw.

Mara Nguyen: Action summary (added to thread):

```
- INF-4321: cloud-network verification & vendor timeline (owner: Jason Li) ETA: 2025-06-05
- TKT-9876: model-registry token-refresh guard + metrics (owner: Sophia Patel) ETA: 2025-06-03
- CHAOS-045: fallback routing chaos test (owner: Alejandro Cruz) ETA/run: 2025-06-10 (staging window 2025-06-08 02:00-06:00 UTC)
- Comms: customer note + FAQ (owner: Zoe Kim) ETA: 2025-06-06
- Runbook: add postmortem checklist + log retention update (owner: Mara Nguyen) ETA: 2025-06-04
- Monthly review: auth errors recurring (owner: Sophia Patel) first run: 2025-06-30
```

Alejandro Cruz: I'll drop a short playbook doc into the INF ticket and ping infra.

Zoe Kim: Will draft customer note and loop in legal if wording needs it.

Mara Nguyen: If no objections, I'll mark this thread as the central handoff and close follow-ups once tickets are green and the chaos run succeeds. Please update the tickets as you progress. Appreciate the quick coordination :heart: 

Jason Li: No objections.

Sophia Patel: Thanks everyone.

eng-bot: ticket INF-4321 status changed to In Progress by Jason Li

eng-bot: ticket TKT-9876 status changed to In Progress by Sophia Patel
